_note_gemini: gemini-3.8-flash: Google's own page https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, Standard paid tier, fetched 2026-10-23: input $0.75, cached input $0.075, output (thinking tokens included) $3.75 per 1M, valid through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 the page lists $1.50 / $0.15 / $7.50. Both are in _effective, which usage::price_on picks by date (the plain entry is the current one, for report.py). No prompt-length tiers. The three agy ids (thinking levels) share one price. Context caching is implicit, with no write charge (storage is billed separately, not modelled).
_note_fable: fable (claude-fable-5-1): Anthropic's pricing page https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, model pricing table row 'Claude Fable 5.1', read 2026-11-02: input $10, 5m cache write $12.50, 1h cache write $20, cache hit $0.25 (0.025x input), output $50 per MTok. Standard pricing at all context lengths per the page's long-context rule. The page names the model 'Claude Fable 5.1' and does not show the id claude-fable-5-1.
_note: USD per million tokens. Third-party sources, checked 2026-10-16; confirm on the providers' pricing pages.
